This Criminal Original Petition has been filed to quash the complaint in C.C.No.131 of 2017, pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate, Ambattur, Chennai.

2. It is the case of the prosecution that one Manna Health Mix, Southern Health Foods Pvt Ltd., is the manufacturer of the alleged Health Drink and the same was sent for analysis and report was received on 10.06.2014, indicating that the sample deviates from the declared value of protein.

Hence the sample was sub-standard, unsafe and misbranded, as per Section 3 (1) (zx), 3 (1) (zz) (v)
(x) and 3 (1) (zf) (A-i) of FSS Act, 2006.
Subsequent, sample sent is also contained the same.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3

. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as Mr.S.Vinoth Kumar, learned Government Advocate (Crl.side) appearing for the respondent and perused the materials available on record.
4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the complaint was filed on 12/5/2017 for the alleged commission of offence on 29/5/2014.

As per Section 77 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the Commissioner of Food Safety, has to record the reasons in writing and accord prosecution within an extended period of upto three years.
Moreover, sanction for prosecution was given only on 12/4/2017, without even ascertaining the particulars of the accused.

Hence prays for quashing C.C.No.131 of 2017, pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate,
Ambattur.
5.

The learned Government Advocate (crl.side) appearing for the respondent produced a letter dated 12/4/2017 of the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai, wherein it is stated that sanction https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis accorded to launch prosecution to the respondent herein for the food sample of Manna Health Mix, which was lifted from Annai Store,
Chennai./A.1.
6.

sentences.text: On a careful perusal of the same, what comes to be known is that sanction has been issued only against the Company and it is not the case of the prosecution that the present petitioner was in charge of the company and moreover, the Company is also not made as an accused.
Accordingly, the entire prosecution launched against the petitioner cannot be sustained in the eye of law.

Therefore,
